goal:
T63 — EvoCore strategies panel on the replay screen (v3.8 §5 made visible: "AI that evolves how AI builds"). Web
only; data from T62: GET /v1/evolution/strategies -> {champion: {strategy_id, strategy, since}, candidates:
[{strategy_id, strategy, runs, evoforge: {rounds, verified, wilson95: [lo, hi]}}], decisions: [{promoted, previous,
...}]} and POST /v1/evolution/strategies/promote {strategy_id} (200, or 404/409 with a reason).
1. apps/web/lib/roundReplay.ts: strategiesView(overview) -> null for null, else {champion: {id, label}, rows, decisions}.
   label = "<N> attempt(s)" (singular for 1) + " · " + ("accumulate critic" | "this round's critic only") + " · " +
   ("retire stale" | "keep stale"). rows: one per candidate {id, label, isChampion, runs, verified "k/n", rate "P%" or
   "—", interval "L–H%" (en dash, Math.round of lo*100 / hi*100) or "—", promotable}, champion row first. promotable is
   true only for a non-champion with rounds > 0 whose lower bound > the champion candidate's upper bound (the
   champion's upper bound is 0 when it has no candidate row or no rounds) — the same rule the server enforces.
   decisions: [{promoted, previous}] in the order given.
2. apps/web/lib/api.ts: getEvolutionStrategies() and promoteEvolutionStrategy(strategy_id) returning {status, body}
   without throwing on 404/409.
3. apps/web/components/StrategiesPanel.tsx: champion card, candidate table (verified, rate, interval bar, runs,
   promotable badge), decision history; a Promote button on promotable rows only, enabled only when
   process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EVO_OPERATOR_CONTROLS === "1", showing the server's reason on 409.
4. Show it on apps/web/app/[locale]/replay/page.tsx below the stats panel.
5. i18n "replay" (en + ko): strategies-title, strategies-champion, strategies-promote, strategies-promotable,
   strategies-history (plus labels you add).
Keep tsc green and every web-structure test green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t63.py.
